Snapshot: enterprise contact-center software provider focused on mid-market telco + fintech accounts. Evaluation for replacing in-house agent assist (current slow rules engine + brittle KB search).

Main requirements (quoted / paraphrase from AE & CTO):
- "We need citations on every suggested snippet — agents must see source and timestamp."
- Sub-200ms median suggestion latency for single-agent flow; 150-250 concurrent live agents target during peak.
- Summaries per ticket (multi-thread) under 120 tokens; auto-populate triage fields.
- Tool-calling: close ticket, update SLA, push macro actions from model outputs (strict audit trail).
- RAG must support multi-source retrieval: Zendesk, Confluence, internal SQL dumps, S3 blobs; freshness windows: real-time changelog + daily full sync.
- Low hallucination tolerance; require provenance + link-back; human-in-loop needed for high-risk intents.
